items.html: And afterward, at the time of the Shema, in 'Shema Yisrael', there is a second pregnancy of Katnut in Tevuna, and then complete Mochin of Katnut enter the HBD of ZA, and the HGT descend into the HGT, and the NHY into the NHY. Then ZA is completed entirely in its externalities, in the three aspects of the vessels, and with all the Mochin of Katnut — pregnancy, nursing, and pregnancy — and the inner and surrounding lights of the Tzelem of Aba and Ima.
